whoFor: Businesses and organisations that need a Tax ID and want their recurring tax administration kept in order with the Nigeria Revenue Service (NRS) and state revenue services.

benefits.title: Registered correctly
benefits.text: The right Tax ID and tax registrations for what you do.

benefits.title: Returns on time
benefits.text: VAT, PAYE and withholding tax prepared to a calendar.

benefits.title: Clean records
benefits.text: A file of what was filed and paid, ready for any review.

whatYouReceive: A tax obligations calendar for your organisation
Preparation and submission of recurring returns within the agreed scope
whatYouProvide: Sales, payroll and payment records for each period
Access or authority to file on your behalf
doesNotInclude: Tax planning, which sits under Tax planning and tax health checks
A promise of an agency's assessment or decision
